Title: Search REST API
Steps:
1. Open redmine.org
2. Enter 'REST API' in search box
3. Press Enter
Expected Result: Search results contain links related to REST API

Title: Project Navigation
Steps:
1. Click 'Projects' link
2. Select 'Redmine' project from the list
Expected Result: Project overview page is displayed correctly

Title: Registration Validation
Steps:
1. Click 'Register' link
2. Leave fields empty and click 'Submit'
Expected Result: Error messages like 'Login can't be blank' are displayed

Title: Roadmap View
Steps:
1. Click 'Roadmap' in the top menu
2. Observe the version list
Expected Result: Version progress bars and issues are visible

Title: Download Section
Steps:
1. Click 'Download' link
2. Check for latest stable release link
Expected Result: Links to download Redmine (SVN or Tarball) are present
